metadata-only.scope: This package includes maintainer-only local validation scripts; project and thread actions are performed by Codex host tools.
metadata-only.reason: Native host actions remain subject to Codex tool and user confirmation boundaries; maintainer scripts are reviewed separately under subprocess approval.

target_enforcement.openai: Host-enforced native project/thread tool permissions; maintainer scripts require subprocess approval.
target_enforcement.claude: Consumer-enforced neutral source permissions; maintainer scripts require subprocess approval.
target_enforcement.generic: Consumer-enforced neutral source permissions; maintainer scripts require subprocess approval.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace and consumer-enforced permissions; maintainer scripts require subprocess approval.

subprocess.scope: Maintainer-only local checks may invoke the fixed regression command and package validators; no remote or user-supplied shell execution is permitted.
subprocess.reason: scripts/ci_test.py uses subprocess.run only to execute the bounded revision regression suite during local release checks.

target_enforcement.openai: Codex host controls tool execution; local maintainer subprocesses run only from the reviewed checkout.
target_enforcement.claude: Consumer controls local script execution; only the reviewed maintainer command is approved.
target_enforcement.generic: Consumer controls local script execution; only the reviewed maintainer command is approved.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust controls local script execution; only the reviewed maintainer command is approved.

file_write.scope: Maintainer-only local packaging and report refresh scripts may write bounded outputs inside the reviewed checkout; no arbitrary user-selected paths are permitted.
file_write.reason: Release scripts generate the runtime archive, adapters, and deterministic evidence files under the checked-out skill directory.

target_enforcement.openai: Codex host controls tool execution; maintainer writes remain bounded to the reviewed checkout.
target_enforcement.claude: Consumer controls local script execution; only reviewed checkout outputs are approved.
target_enforcement.generic: Consumer controls local script execution; only reviewed checkout outputs are approved.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust controls local script execution; only reviewed checkout outputs are approved.
